event: Grace Baptist Kisumu, founded by Pastor Samuel Oluoch with 12 families meeting in a rented hall.
Congregation grew to 100 members. Broke ground and built on their own premises.
Grace Baptist Church Nairobi was planted starting with home fellowship at Pastor Sam's.
Student ministries grew the membership and started meetig at Wildlife Club.
Grace Baptist Church was constituted with a membership of 40 at Lang'ata Botanicals
Settled at Karen Kufuga Lane and membership grew to 80
